g.title: NotebookAWS
g.text: Design specification only • AWS backend not yet implemented

g.title: status
g.text: Mark Synced only after server acknowledgement

g.title: safety_grid
g.text: Read OP record; compare canonical request hash
Race → conditional OP create, then reread
Note create / move checks folder state = ACTIVE
Every mutation transaction checks deletion control record
Notes use tombstones; stale writes cannot resurrect
Folder enters DELETING; block new references and check remaining notes
Presigned URL → direct S3 upload → verify + activate

g.title: tx
g.text: • Folder ACTIVE ConditionCheck when assigning a folder
• Content snapshot only for content edits
